app.name: Werewolf Online by Ryan
app.tagline: Run a live Werewolf game — scan a QR code, get your role, vote on your phone.

home.createDesc: Create a new room and show the QR code for everyone to scan.
home.joinDesc: Enter the room code the Host gave you.
home.how1: The Host opens the app on a laptop or projector and creates a room.
home.how2: Everyone scans the QR code and types a name — no account, no app install.
home.how3: Roles are sent secretly to each phone. Act at night, vote by day — all on your phone.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Each night the pack agrees on one victim to devour. By day, pretend to be an innocent villager.

villager.name: Villager
villager.desc: No special power. Use reasoning and intuition to find the Werewolves.

seer.name: Seer
seer.desc: Each night, inspect one player to learn whether they are a Werewolf.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Each night, protect one player from the Werewolves. You can’t protect the same person two nights in a row.

witch.name: Witch
witch.desc: You have one healing potion and one poison, each usable once. You learn who the Werewolves attacked.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: When you die, you take one other player down with you.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.desc: On the first night, link two players as lovers. If one dies, the other dies of heartbreak.
cupid.action: Choose two players to fall in love

script.title: Narration
script.lobby: Welcome, villagers! Scan the QR code on the screen and enter your name to join.
script.roleReveal: Press and hold the card on your phone to see your role. Don’t let anyone peek! When everyone is ready, the first night begins.
script.nightStart: Night {n} falls. Everyone, close your eyes…

step.cupid: Cupid, wake up. Choose two players to fall in love… Cupid, go back to sleep.
step.bodyguard: Bodyguard, wake up. Who will you protect tonight?… Bodyguard, go back to sleep.
step.werewolf: Werewolves, wake up and recognise each other. Who will you devour tonight?… Werewolves, go back to sleep.
step.witch: Witch, wake up. This is tonight’s victim. Will you use your healing potion? Will you use your poison on anyone?… Witch, go back to sleep.
step.seer: Seer, wake up. Whose identity will you reveal tonight?… Seer, go back to sleep.

script.stepNobody: (This role is dead or absent — still read the line and pause a few seconds so nothing is given away.)
script.dawnDeaths: The sun rises — everyone, open your eyes. Sadly, last night {names} passed away.
script.dawnNone: The sun rises — everyone, open your eyes. Last night was peaceful — nobody died!
script.hunter: {name} was the Hunter! Before falling, choose someone to take down with you.
script.hunterShot: A shot rings out… {name} has been hit.
script.hunterMissed: The Hunter lowers the gun and shoots no one.
script.discussion: Villagers, discuss and find the Werewolves. Who is the most suspicious?
script.nominate: Time to vote. Everyone, choose one player to put on trial — or skip.
script.nominateResultDefense: The votes are in! {names} must stand trial.
script.nominateResultNone: The votes are in. Nobody goes on trial — night is about to fall again…
script.nominateResultRevote: It’s a tie between {names}! The village will vote again between them.
script.verdict: Village, decide the fate of {name}: EXECUTE or SPARE?
script.verdictExecuted: With {execute} votes to execute and {spare} to spare, {name} has been executed.
script.verdictSpared: With {execute} votes to execute and {spare} to spare, {name} is spared.
script.gameOver: The game is over! Let’s reveal every role and look back at what happened.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Werewolf Online is a free web app for running live Werewolf games. This page explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.p1: Without signing in: your display name, emoji, the name style and frame you pick, and game data (roles, votes). Guest profiles are only stored in your browser.
privacy.p2: With Google sign-in: we only receive your Google account identifier, your name and your public profile photo. We never receive your password and never read your email, contacts or any other Google data.
privacy.p3: Profile photos you upload are resized and stored on our server so they can be shown in games.
privacy.p4: Your data is only used to show your name, photo and profile to the players in your room. We don’t sell it, share it with third parties or use it for advertising.
privacy.p5: Game rooms are deleted automatically after 12 hours of inactivity. You can remove an uploaded photo on the Profile page at any time. To delete your account entirely, send a request on the GitHub project page below.
